read.thesis: Deere Q1 FY26 net income fell 25% to $656M, but Construction & Forestry and Small Ag sales rose 34% and 24%; FY26 net income guide raised to $4.5-5.0B while large-ag US & Canada industry is guided down 15-20%.

triggers.label: FY26 net income guide raised to $4.5-5.0B
triggers.quote: Net income guidance range increased to $4.5 billion - $5.0 billion

triggers.label: Small Ag price realization positive
triggers.quote: higher shipment volumes / sales mix and price realization, partially offset by higher tariffs

guidance.metric: FY26 net income attributable to Deere
guidance.quote: Net income guidance range increased to $4.5 billion - $5.0 billion

red_flags.label: Production & Precision Ag margin 4.4% vs 11.0%
red_flags.quote: Operating profit decreased primarily due to higher tariffs, unfavorable sales mix, and higher warranty expenses.
